counter.name: Counter
counter.desc: When an enemy attack hits you, strike back for 2.

repel.name: Repel
repel.desc: When an enemy attack hits you, shove the attacker back a tile.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: Once per battle, when you drop to half HP or less, heal 4.

burning_riposte.name: Burning Riposte
burning_riposte.desc: When an enemy attack hits you, burn the attacker for 3 fire.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.desc: You can't be pushed, pulled, shoved or swapped.

blink.name: Blink
blink.desc: Step to any tile on your grid.

float.name: Float
float.desc: Hover over the ground: lava and spikes don't hurt you in battle, and the party can cross lava on the map.

ember_walk.name: Ember Walk
ember_walk.desc: Fire and lava tiles don't hurt you.
